About Karbon

Karbon is the global leader in AI-powered practice management software for accounting firms. We provide an award-winning cloud platform that helps tens of thousands of accounting professionals work more efficiently and collaboratively every day. With customers in 40 countries, we have grown into a globally distributed team across the US, Australia, New Zealand, Canada, the United Kingdom, and the Philippines. We are well-funded, ranked #1 on G2, growing rapidly, and have a people-first culture that is recognized with Great Place To Work® certification and on Fortune magazine's Best Small Workplaces™ List.

About the Role:

As an Implementation Specialist, you will lead customers through onboarding, data migration, implementation, and training for small to mid-sized firms. You’ll act as a trusted partner during the implementation phase, supporting customers as they adopt Karbon and ensuring they achieve rapid time-to-value and long-term success on the Karbon platform.

As an Implementation Specialist, you will...

  • Facilitate structured onboarding: Lead kickoff meetings, configuration sessions, and training sessions using established frameworks and playbooks, adapting delivery to customer needs.
  • Provide professional guidance: Guide customers on Karbon best practices for workflow setup and day-to-day usage, helping firms establish efficient and repeatable processes.
  • Coach through change management: Help customers

description:
About Flock

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

About the role

More fleets are choosing Flock and our Customer Success team needs to grow. You will own a book of customers outright: onboarding them, keeping them engaged with their data, and getting them to renewal in better shape than they started. The role is built around the conversations our telematics makes possible, from quarterly reviews with fleet managers to safety interventions that follow a spike in risky driving, alongside a steady variety of inbound queries by phone and email. You hear first hand what matters to customers and brokers, and your suggestions for improving how we work carry real weight. AI is part of the day job too, because Flock runs on it. You will use it to prepare for meetings, dig into fleet data and stay on top of your book. You do not need insurance experience. You need the service instincts that make clients want to deal with you, and the appetite to learn everything else.

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Every contact that reaches a customer support agent, and every credit issued to customers, represents a defect somewhere in our system. This role exists to help find those defects, trace them to their source, and work with the teams responsible to eliminate them at a systemic level.

This is a high impact senior program management role within the EMEA Customer Experience organisation, reporting to the Director of Defect Elimination and Customer Experience. title: AI Security Field CTO
Forward Deployed Scientist II
description:
Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?

Your mission

This is one of the most exciting problems in applied AI right now: take the cutting edge of machine learning, optimisation, and agentic systems, and make it work inside real businesses — not in a lab, but on live customer problems where the answer has to hold up commercially.

As a Forward Deployed Scientist II, in our Supply Chain & Retail business, you’ll work directly with some of the world’s biggest retailers and manufacturers on hard, high-stakes problems: demand forecasting, price and promotion optimisation, and supply-chain decisioning. You’ll own the science end-to-end — from understanding a customer’s messy reality to shipping something that changes how they operate.

And you won’t just deliver. What you learn on the front line feeds directly back into the products we build, so you’re shaping the capability the whole business runs on — not just solving one problem at a time.

 

What you'll do at UiPath

  • Own customer engagements end-to-end — frame the problem, build the solution, and drive it to real commercial impact, working directly alongside customer teams.

title: Customer Success Manager
description: I-care est le leader mondial de la maintenance prédictive et prescriptive. Nos solutions de surveillance d'état basées sur l'IA et guidées par les données prédisent les pannes industrielles avant tout le monde. Grâce à nos méthodes, produits et services innovants, nous gérons plus de 500 000 équipements et processus clients à travers le monde, en les aidant à réduire les risques pour une production plus sûre, plus efficace et plus durable. Fondée en 2004 et basée en Belgique, I-care emploie plus de 1 000 personnes et possède des bureaux dans plus de 20 pays (Europe, États-Unis et Asie). Elle a été nommée Entreprise de l'année 2020.  I-care recherche un(e) Customer Success Manager (CSM) expérimenté(e) pour incarner notre ambassadeur de « confiance technique » (Technical Trust). Vous veillerez à ce que les clients tirent la valeur maximale de nos solutions de maintenance prédictive, en stimulant la croissance organique et en faisant le pont entre les spécialistes en IA d'I-care et les opérations sur site.   Votre mission  Accompagner les clients depuis les projets pilotes initiaux jusqu'au déploiement à grande échelle à l'échelle de l'entreprise, tout en maintenant un taux de rétention de 100 % (Zero T-churn). Vous agirez en tant que consultant stratégique, aidant les clients à faire évoluer la maturité de leur maintenance industrielle.   Responsabilités principales        Partenariat stratégique :  Développer un réseau allant des techniciens d'usine aux cadres dirigeants (C-suite).    Traducteur technique :  Interpréter les données complexes relatives à l'IA et aux vibrations en informations exploitables pour le client.    Croissance et conversion :  Identifier les opportunités d'extension et piloter la conversion des projets pilotes en déploiements à grande échelle.    Excellence opérationnelle :  Gérer le suivi mensuel et les visites sur site (minimum 12 par trimestre).    Gestion de comptes :  Maintenir un cycle de réponse sous 24 heures et utiliser Mo

Vanuit Solutions Delivery realiseert de organisatie complexe integrale beveiligingsoplossingen waarin technologie, mobiele surveillance, monitoring en beveiliging samenkomen. De afdeling vormt de schakel tussen sales, operatie en klant en is verantwoordelijk voor de succesvolle implementatie van deze oplossingen. Door de groei van de dienstverlening, de ontwikkeling van medewerkers en de toenemende impact op de organisatie is deze functie ontstaan. De internationale Solutions-organisatie biedt daarnaast interessante doorgroeimogelijkheden.  Als Solutions Transitie- en Implementatiemanager maak je deel uit van de afdeling Solutions Delivery. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de succesvolle implementatie van integrale beveiligingsoplossingen bij strategische klanten. Deze oplossingen bestaan uit een combinatie van technologie, monitoring, mobiele surveillance, manbeveiliging en aanvullende security services, afgestemd op de specifieke risico's, dreigingen en bedrijfsprocessen van de klant.  Je bent al betrokken tijdens de salesfase en neemt na opdrachtverstrekking de regie over het implementatietraject. Je fungeert als centraal aanspreekpunt voor zowel klanten als interne stakeholders, valideert de ontwikkelde oplossing, stelt projectplannen op en zorgt voor een succesvolle overdracht naar de operationele organisatie. In deze rol ligt de nadruk op regievoering: je brengt commerciële, operationele en technische disciplines samen, stemt belangen af en zorgt ervoor dat alle betrokken partijen effectief samenwerken aan een succesvolle implementatie van de overeengekomen oplossing.  Bij wijzigingen in klantwensen of projectscope analyseer je de impact op zowel de klantorganisatie als Securitas. Je signaleert risico's, stuurt tijdig bij en zorgt ervoor dat projecten gecontroleerd, beheerst en succesvol verlopen.   Daarnaast Ben Je Verantwoo

title: Deployment Strategist
description: What You'll Do    As a Deployment Strategist at Wonderful, you are responsible for making AI deployments actually land.  Wonderful is the AI operating system for enterprises, helping them close the gap between what AI enables and how they operate today. You lead enterprise customers from early discovery through pilot and production rollout, translating ambitious AI initiatives into clear scopes, executable plans, and measurable outcomes. You sit between the customer, Forward Deployed Engineers, and Product, ensuring everyone is aligned on what is being built, why it matters, and how it will succeed in production.  This is a hands-on role for people who enjoy ambiguity, ownership, and seeing complex projects through to the end.    Embed deeply with customers to understand their processes and systems, identify the most important problems to solve, and obsess over helping them win.   Lead discovery with enterprise customers to understand workflows, constraints, and success criteria.   Define scope, success metrics, and integration plans for pilots and rollouts.   Translate customer needs into clear deployment plans for engineering teams.   Coordinate deployments across Product, Engineering, and customer stakeholders.   Track progress, manage risks, and remove blockers throughout the deployment.   Support production launches and ensure solutions are adopted and working as intended.   Monitor deployed agents and drive follow-up improvements based on real usage.   Identify additional use cases and expansion opportunities with customers.     You will spend time onsite with customers, working through real constraints, answering difficult questions, and ensuring solutions deliver real value.    Why Should You      You’ll be part of what is tipped as the fastest-growing startup in Europe.   Work on a cutting-edge agentic solution, the hottest topic in Enterprise right now.   You’ll join a team of high-agency builders coming from the best tech companies out there.   Never

title: (Senior) Applied Scientist, Recommendations
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Wolt is part of DoorDash - together we form one of the world's largest local commerce platforms. We build recommendation systems that help customers discover the most relevant restaurants, dishes and items throughout their Wolt experience.

We are looking for an Applied Scientist to advance the machine learning models behind these experiences. You'll work on challenging applied ML problems where model quality, product decisions and customer experience are tightly connected. This is an opportunity to take ideas from problem framing and data analysis through experimentation, production deployment and measurable customer impact.

What you'll be doing

  • Design, develop and improve recommendation, ranking and retrieval models that surface relevant restaurants, dishes, items and content to customers.
  • Own applied ML problems end to end: frame the problem, analyze data, develop models, define offline evaluation, run experiments and monitor production performance.
  • Develop methods that balance relevance with product and customer needs, such as diversity, availability, business constraints and changing

description: The short version Appetise has gone through a strong period of growth, with a product suite FMCG brands genuinely love and a team that has punched well above its weight.  The next chapter needs something we have never had: one person who owns the whole commercial engine. Sales and customer success, the systems underneath them, and the number at the end of it.  We are taking ANZ from $3-4M to $10M and opening the US. This is the role that makes the first part happen.  If you are currently one of several commercial leaders inside a large business, this is the job where you build the entire thing instead.    What Appetise does We help FMCG brands sell more.  Around 80% of new product launches die within 12-18 months, mostly because brands are guessing. They have no real visibility into how people actually shop, and no system for turning that into better decisions.  We have spent four years collecting genuine behavioural shopping data, and we turn it into two things brands pay for. A performance advertising channel that only charges them when we drive an actual sale in a supermarket, which is a first in this category. And an insights product that tells them what to build next.  Nobody else in the category has both. That is the whole business.  We raised an $8M Series A in late 2025. We are around 25 people across Australia and New Zealand, and we open the US in 2027.    Why this role exists now Our commercial growth so far has been founder-led. That is how most companies get to $3-5M. It is not how they get to $50M.  Today we have a sales team generating genuine pipeline, a customer success team our customers are loyal to, and marketers who think in unit economics. What we have never had is one person whose entire job is to bring those together, set the standard, and build the infrastructure that lets a team of eight become a team of twenty. description: Coretura is building the software backbone for the next generation of commercial vehicles - a joint venture between two of the industry's biggest players, moving at scaleup speed. As Customer Success Manager, you'll sit at the center of that relationship, turning shareholder alignment into product momentum.    Our Vision & Mission   Coretura exists to build a Software Defined Vehicle (SDV) platform that redefines how commercial vehicles are engineered, updated, and monetized - jointly owned by Volvo Group and Daimler Truck, two competitors who are betting that shared infrastructure beats separate roads. Our mission is to deliver a common platform robust enough to serve multiple OEMs, while still giving each shareholder room to differentiate and win in their own markets. This is a company in active build-mode: fast-scaling, still shaping its own structures, and defined by the ambition to make software the center of gravity in trucking.   Your Quest   Coretura serves two OEM shareholders who are simultaneously its customers, a structural setup that creates constant, real tension: whose priorities get championed first, how do you keep a platform genuinely common when both owners want to differentiate, and what happens when one side's ask risks disadvantaging the other?  On top of that, the product itself is still under creation, and that creation often means guiding a broader shift from hardware-centric thinking toward a software-first mindset. We are building the platform and bringing the customers along for the ride at the same time, which makes for a different kind of relationship than you'd have with an established product. This calls for someone who can stay close to the customer commercially and relationally, build a genuine business case for why and how they engage with the platform, set and manage realistic expectations continuously, and be comfortable challenging the customer with integrity and assertiveness, all while never losing sight of the platform

title: Product Marketing Manager, Growth
description: TL;DR -  Lovable's product-led growth motion has been core to its success, and messaging is one of the biggest levers we have to move users from signup to activation to expansion. This role owns that lever: the messaging and positioning strategy for the self serve journey.  You'll own how we talk to self serve users at every stage, from the words in an onboarding email to the framing of an upgrade prompt. You'll partner closely with the Growth PM, who owns the growth roadmap and the product/experimentation strategy behind it, and with our Lifecycle team, who execute lifecycle campaigns day to day. Your job is to bring the messaging point of view: what story we should be telling at each stage, which positioning will land best with which segment, and what new content or messaging should be created to support the roadmap the Growth PM has set.   Why Lovable?   Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.  We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world. title: Associate Relationship Manager - London
description:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Our vision is to reimagine Relationship Banking for established SMEs, through the very best people, products and digital tools. Allica’s Relationship Management team was formed in 2022 and continues to grow at pace, providing established SME customers with expert human relationships alongside modern banking technology.

The team supports customers with lending, current accounts, savings, asset finance and working capital facilities, while building deep local relationships with SME customers, trusted professional advisers and business communities.

The Associate Relationship Manager role is a newly created position that is a key step in our ambition to build the best Relationship team to support our SME clients. The successful candidate will manage a portfolio of clients and be expected to deliver across a range of commercial, customer service and risk objectives whilst also providing support to the wider relationship team as part of their development.

This is a great opportunity for someone looking to develop their skills and progress a career as an SME Relationship Manager.

This is not your typical Customer Success role.

That means Customer Success at RevenueCat should be more than relationship management, implementation check-ins, and polite QBRs.

Our best CSMs understand a customer’s app, audience, business model, growth goals, internal constraints, RevenueCat usage, and decision-making dynamics well enough to help that customer make better decisions.

Sometimes that means helping them adopt the right RevenueCat feature.

Sometimes it means spotting that their paywall, pricing, lifecycle, onboarding, or retention motion deserves a closer look.

Sometimes it means bringing in a technical partner to make sure an implementation question gets answered correctly.

Sometimes it means bringing in one of our growth specialists — people with deep expertise in areas like paywall conversion, lifecycle messaging, paid user acquisition, pricing, or gaming monetization — when a customer has a specific high-impact growth problem worth digging into.

title: Service Delivery Manager
description: Colt provides network, voice and data centre services to thousands of businesses around the world, allowing them to focus on delivering their business goals instead of the underlying infrastructure.   Why we need this role   As Colt continues to strengthen its customer-centric approach, demand for its Network and Capital Market services continues to grow. The delivery of customer services requires close coordination among customers, internal teams, key stakeholders, and external vendors. As a result, effective coordination, communication, and schedule management are critical to ensuring successful service delivery.  The Service Delivery Manager is responsible for managing the end-to-end service delivery process, from order initiation through service activation, ensuring that customer requirements are delivered accurately and on time. The role also proactively manages delivery risks, delays, and operational issues, contributing to customer satisfaction, service quality, and timely revenue realization.   What You Will Do     Support internal network infrastructure deployment, expansion, migration, and upgrading projects.  Coordinate customer and internal kick-off meetings for new service implementations and manage service delivery activities.  Coordinate project schedules and activities with customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders.  Manage supplier engagements, purchase orders, lead times, and service delivery schedules.  Coordinate customer site activities, access arrangements, and implementation schedules.  Monitor project progress and proactively manage issues, risks, and dependencies.  Manage data center activities, including cross-connect installations, equipment deployment, relocation, and decommissioning.  Coordinate field engineers and third-party vendors to ensure timely delivery and quality standards.  Collaborate with data center operations teams and facility managers to enhance service quality and operational efficiency.  Manage network

Strong portfolio and stakeholder management capability: you’ve led enterprise customers through steady-state delivery and tricky moments alike, you can build trusted governance relationships, and you’re confident owning escalations and turning risk into a plan.
